title: Inference-Time Scaling for Generalist Reward Modeling
authors_zh: Zijun Liu；Peiyi Wang；Runxin Xu；Shirong Ma；Chong Ruan；Peng Li；Yang Liu；Yu Wu
paper_type_zh: Rollout、搜索或测试时推理轨迹研究

one_line: A generalist reward-model pipeline whose inference-time scaling relies on generated principles and critiques.
该工作以 SPCT 让通用生成式奖励模型在线生成原则和批评，再以并行采样和 Meta RM 投票扩展奖励判断的测试时计算。
why: It belongs in Track 5 as verifier infrastructure, while its closed data lineage makes it unsuitable to represent as an open trace corpus.
inclusion_reason: It belongs in Track 5 as verifier infrastructure, while its closed data lineage makes it unsuitable to represent as an open trace corpus.

title: Problem
问题
html:
The official arXiv preprint asks whether a generalist reward model can improve its judgments by spending more inference compute, especially on queries for which correctness is not available from an executable verifier. Scalar reward models are efficient but emit a narrow score, while ordinary LLM-as-a-Judge or critique models do not necessarily improve when repeatedly sampled. The paper therefore studies both a learning recipe for scalable reward generation and an aggregation procedure at test time.

The auditable object is a reward-generation trajectory over one query and one or more candidate responses: generated principles, textual critiques, pointwise scores, correctness labels used during training, repeated reward samples, and optional Meta RM weights. DeepSeek-GRM is verifier infrastructure, not a released rollout corpus. Official 16B, 27B, and MetaRM model checkpoints are listed in the linked Hugging Face collection, but the mixed internal/open training manifest, raw principles and critiques, and item-level lineage were not confirmed as released.

官方 arXiv preprint 研究通用奖励模型能否通过增加推理时计算改善判断，尤其面向无法用可执行 verifier 直接给出正确性的通用查询。标量奖励模型效率高但只输出窄化分数；普通 LLM-as-a-Judge 或 critique model 也未必会随重复采样持续改善。因此，论文同时研究可扩展奖励生成的学习配方和测试时聚合流程。

可审计对象是围绕一个 query 与一个或多个候选 response 的奖励生成轨迹：生成的原则、文本 critique、pointwise score、训练中使用的正确性标签、重复奖励样本以及可选的 Meta RM 权重。DeepSeek-GRM 属于 verifier 基础设施，而非已发布 rollout 语料。官方 Hugging Face collection 列出 16B、27B 和 MetaRM checkpoint，但混合内部/开放训练 manifest、原始原则与 critique 及条目级 lineage 未确认发布。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
Self-Principled Critique Tuning (SPCT) moves principles inside reward generation: a pointwise generative reward model produces input-adaptive principles, critiques candidate responses under those principles, and emits scores in one language-model format for single, paired, or multiple responses. Rejective Fine-Tuning supplies the cold start; rule-based online RL then rewards outputs whose extracted score ordering agrees with the available ground-truth preference or correctness label.

At inference, DeepSeek-GRM samples several principle–critique–score trajectories after shuffling response order. Plain voting sums pointwise scores, expanding the aggregate score range. Meta RM guided voting additionally learns whether a generated principle/critique trajectory is likely correct and keeps the top kmeta trajectories before aggregation. The feedback contract is mixed: rule-based accuracy against labels trains SPCT and Meta RM, but deployment-time judgments remain model-generated. Compared with scalar RMs, semi-scalar critique models, and ordinary LLM-as-a-Judge, the contribution is the coupling of self-generated criteria, online RL, and explicit inference-time reward scaling.

Self-Principled Critique Tuning（SPCT）把原则移入奖励生成过程：pointwise generative reward model 针对输入自适应生成原则，依据这些原则 critique 候选 response，并以统一语言模型格式为单个、成对或多个 response 输出分数。Rejective Fine-Tuning 提供 cold start；rule-based online RL 再奖励那些提取后分数排序与现有 ground-truth preference 或正确性标签一致的输出。

推理时，DeepSeek-GRM 在打乱 response 顺序后采样多条“原则—critique—分数”轨迹。普通 voting 对 pointwise score 求和，从而扩大聚合分数空间；Meta RM guided voting 还学习判断一条原则/critique 轨迹是否可能正确，并在聚合前保留 Meta RM 分数最高的 kmeta 条轨迹。反馈契约是 mixed：SPCT 和 Meta RM 训练使用相对于标签的规则式准确性，但部署时判断仍由模型生成。相较 scalar RM、semi-scalar critique model 与普通 LLM-as-a-Judge，贡献在于把自生成标准、online RL 和显式推理时奖励扩展结合起来。

title: Method
方法
html:
For the 27B recipe, the paper reports 1,256K Rejective Fine-Tuning examples: 1,070K in-house general-instruction examples and 186K rejectively sampled reward-model examples, plus 237K examples for rule-based RL. Reward-model data mix internal sources with MATH, UltraFeedback, OffsetBias, Skywork-Reward-Preference-80K-v0.2, and HelpSteer2-Preference. Some UltraFeedback preferences are re-tagged; MATH trajectories are filtered by ground-truth matching; single-response verifiable items receive binary correctness rewards. The complete source manifest, item provenance, and licenses are not disclosed.

DeepSeek-v2.5-0905 samples principles and critiques three times per reward-model item for the cold start. Incorrect trajectories and items for which all samples are already correct are rejected; hinted sampling supplies the labeled best response for difficult cases, while non-hinted sampling preserves unguided trajectories. SPCT then applies GRPO with a +1 or −1 outcome reward according to whether extracted pointwise scores match the single-response label or correctly rank the unique best response. The 27B model uses a KL coefficient selected for stability, group size 4, and 900 steps each for RFT and RL; the paper reports 128 A100 GPUs for training.

For test-time scaling, the model samples reward trajectories at temperature 0.5, shuffles candidate order, and aggregates up to 32 samples by summed scores. A Gemma-2-27B-based Meta RM is trained with binary cross-entropy on labeled correct/incorrect principle–critique trajectories from cold-start and on-policy data, then guides voting; the default Meta RM sample budget is half the reward-sample count. The official model collection exposes checkpoints, but no confirmed code, raw RFT/RL records, generated critique logs, or exact inference harness was found.

论文对 27B 配方报告了 1,256K 条 Rejective Fine-Tuning 数据，其中 1,070K 为内部 general-instruction 数据，186K 为拒绝采样的 reward-model 数据；另有 237K 条 rule-based RL 数据。Reward-model 数据混合内部来源与 MATH、UltraFeedback、OffsetBias、Skywork-Reward-Preference-80K-v0.2、HelpSteer2-Preference。部分 UltraFeedback preference 被重新标注；MATH 轨迹按 ground-truth matching 过滤；单 response 的可验证条目使用二值正确性奖励。完整来源 manifest、条目 provenance 与许可证未披露。

Cold start 阶段由 DeepSeek-v2.5-0905 为每个 reward-model 条目采样三次原则和 critique。错误轨迹以及所有采样都已正确的过易条目会被拒绝；hinted sampling 为困难样本提供已标注的最佳 response，non-hinted sampling 则保留无提示轨迹。SPCT 随后使用 GRPO：若提取的 pointwise score 符合单 response 标签，或能正确排序唯一最佳 response，则给予 +1，否则为 −1。27B 模型使用为稳定性选择的 KL 系数、group size 4，RFT 与 RL 各训练 900 step；论文报告使用 128 张 A100。

测试时，模型以 temperature 0.5 采样奖励轨迹，打乱候选顺序，并通过分数求和聚合最多 32 个样本。基于 Gemma-2-27B 的 Meta RM 使用 binary cross-entropy，在 cold-start 与 on-policy 产生的正确/错误原则—critique 轨迹上训练，再用于引导 voting；默认 Meta RM 样本预算为奖励样本数的一半。官方 model collection 提供 checkpoint，但未确认代码、原始 RFT/RL 记录、生成 critique 日志或精确推理 harness。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The paper evaluates Reward Bench, PPE Preference, PPE Correctness, and RMB, reporting both greedy decoding and inference-time scaling. In its aggregate Table 2, DeepSeek-GRM-27B scores 69.9 overall under greedy decoding; summed-score voting with 32 samples is reported at 71.0, and Meta RM guided voting at 72.8. Ablations remove principle generation, rejective sampling, general instruction data, and hinted or non-hinted sampling. The paper also reports that some verifiable-task settings remain weaker than scalar reward models.

These results are evidence about reward-model benchmark behavior and how the proposed aggregation responds to added sampling. They do not validate every generated principle or critique, prove that the mixed training data are high quality, or establish that the Meta RM is unbiased. The official arXiv v3 record and Hugging Face collection were verified; the collection lists DeepSeek-GRM-16B, DeepSeek-GRM-27B, and DeepSeek-GRM-27B-MetaRM. No official code or raw training/trajectory dataset was confirmed in the accepted metadata.

论文在 Reward Bench、PPE Preference、PPE Correctness 与 RMB 上评测，同时报告 greedy decoding 和 inference-time scaling。其汇总 Table 2 中，DeepSeek-GRM-27B 在 greedy decoding 下总体得分为 69.9；32 个样本的分数求和 voting 报告为 71.0，Meta RM guided voting 为 72.8。消融实验分别移除 principle generation、rejective sampling、general instruction data，以及 hinted 或 non-hinted sampling。论文也报告在部分可验证任务设置中仍落后于 scalar reward model。

这些结果证明的是奖励模型 benchmark 行为及所提聚合方式对增加采样的响应，不能验证每条生成原则或 critique，也不能证明混合训练数据质量高或 Meta RM 无偏。官方 arXiv v3 记录与 Hugging Face collection 已核实；collection 列出 DeepSeek-GRM-16B、DeepSeek-GRM-27B 和 DeepSeek-GRM-27B-MetaRM。已接受元数据中未确认官方代码或原始训练/轨迹数据集。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Earlier scalar RMs provide efficient but fixed-dimensional rewards; critique-augmented or generative judges add text but are not necessarily trained to improve under repeated sampling. SPCT's main change is to make the evaluation principles themselves generated, condition them on the current query and candidate set, and optimize the joint principle–critique–score behavior with rule-based online RL. The Meta RM then treats sampled reward trajectories as objects that can be evaluated before aggregation.

For the atlas, this is a direction signal because verifier output becomes a search trace: multiple judgment perspectives, critiques, scores, and second-order selections contribute to one reward. A reusable release would expose that hierarchy rather than only final scalar scores. Generative critiques, preference labels, GRPO, voting, and learned reward models are not individually novel. The reported benchmark scaling is a quality signal for the end-to-end judge, not proof that the underlying principles, critiques, labels, or source mixture are independently correct.

既有 scalar RM 高效但奖励维度固定；带 critique 的模型或 generative judge 虽能输出文本，却未必经过面向重复采样增益的训练。SPCT 的主要变化是让评测原则本身也由模型生成，使其依赖当前 query 与候选集合，并用 rule-based online RL 联合优化“原则—critique—分数”行为。Meta RM 随后把采样得到的奖励轨迹当作可在聚合前再次评估的对象。

对本图谱而言，这是方向信号，因为 verifier 输出由此成为搜索轨迹：多个判断视角、critique、分数和二阶筛选共同形成一个奖励。可复用发布应暴露这一层级，而非只给最终 scalar score。Generative critique、preference label、GRPO、voting 和 learned reward model 均非单独的新发明。论文报告的 benchmark scaling 是端到端 judge 的质量信号，不证明底层原则、critique、标签或来源混合分别正确。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The paper states that generative RMs are substantially less efficient than same-scale scalar RMs and that DeepSeek-GRM can lag scalar models on verifiable tasks. Its possible use as a process reward model is suggested rather than established. Parallel sampling reduces wall-clock latency only when sufficient parallel hardware is available; total generated tokens and serving cost still grow. Meta RM guided voting adds another learned model whose distribution shift and failure correlations matter.

The 1,070K general-instruction component is in-house, and the reward mixture combines internal and public data without a complete manifest or per-item license lineage. Re-tagging preferences, rule-based MATH filtering, hinted sampling, and rejection of easy cases all alter the training distribution. Model-generated principles and critiques may rationalize existing bias or take shortcuts; the paper itself observes hinted-trajectory shortcuts and sensitivity to KL regularization. Released checkpoints improve artifact access, but raw examples, sampling failures, rejected trajectories, seeds, and code remain unverified. Benchmark gains therefore cannot substitute for data or verifier audits.

论文指出，generative RM 的效率明显低于同规模 scalar RM，且 DeepSeek-GRM 在可验证任务上可能落后于 scalar model。其作为 process reward model 的用途只是推测，尚未得到充分验证。并行采样只有在具备充足并行硬件时才会减少 wall-clock latency，总生成 token 与服务成本仍随样本数增加；Meta RM guided voting 还引入第二个 learned model，其分布偏移和相关失败不可忽略。

1,070K general-instruction 数据来自内部，reward mixture 也混合内部与公开来源，却没有完整 manifest 或逐条许可证 lineage。Preference 重标、MATH 规则过滤、hinted sampling 和剔除过易条目都会改变训练分布。模型生成的原则与 critique 可能合理化既有偏差或走捷径；论文自身也观察到 hinted trajectory 捷径和对 KL 正则的敏感性。已发布 checkpoint 提高了 artifact 可用性，但原始样本、采样失败、拒绝轨迹、seed 与代码仍未核实。Benchmark 增益不能替代数据或 verifier 审计。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
Within the Rollout, Search, and Test-Time Trace Data track, DeepSeek-GRM is a verifier-side scaling study. It is useful for analyzing how extra compute is allocated not to solution generation but to repeated judgments, and how a second verifier selects among those judgments. This distinction matters in post-training pipelines: a policy improvement attributed to better data may instead come from a larger reward-sampling budget or a Meta RM.

A reusable record should preserve the source item and license, query, ordered candidate responses, ground-truth preference or correctness label, shuffled order, hinted/non-hinted flag, every generated principle and critique, extracted pointwise scores, rejection reason, GRPO reward, checkpoint, temperature, sample count, Meta RM probability, selected samples, aggregate score, and benchmark outcome. Reward-model training records and inference-time judging traces should remain separate. The released model collection supports evaluation use, but absence of raw lineage prevents treating the work as an open feedback-data release.

在 Rollout, Search, and Test-Time Trace Data 分类中，DeepSeek-GRM 是 verifier 侧的 scaling study。它可用于分析额外计算如何分配给重复判断而非解题生成，以及第二个 verifier 如何筛选这些判断。这一区分对 post-training pipeline 很重要：被归因于“更好数据”的 policy 改善，实际可能来自更大的奖励采样预算或 Meta RM。

可复用记录应保存来源条目与许可证、query、有序候选 response、ground-truth preference 或正确性标签、打乱后的顺序、hinted/non-hinted 标记、每条生成原则与 critique、提取的 pointwise score、拒绝原因、GRPO reward、checkpoint、temperature、样本数、Meta RM 概率、被选样本、聚合分数与 benchmark 结果。奖励模型训练记录和推理时判断轨迹应分开。已发布 model collection 支持评测使用，但原始 lineage 缺失，因此不能把该工作表述为开放反馈数据发布。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• SPCT combines Rejective Fine-Tuning with rule-based GRPO over generated principles, critiques, and scores.
  • The 27B recipe reports 1,256K RFT examples and 237K RL examples, including a large in-house component.
  • Inference-time scaling sums repeated pointwise scores; Meta RM guided voting evaluates sampled judgment trajectories.
  • Official 16B, 27B, and MetaRM checkpoints are listed, but raw data, critiques, and code were not confirmed.
  • Reward-benchmark scaling evaluates the judge pipeline; it is not proof of trace or source-mixture quality.

• SPCT 将 Rejective Fine-Tuning 与针对生成原则、critique 和分数的 rule-based GRPO 结合。
  • 27B 配方报告 1,256K 条 RFT 数据和 237K 条 RL 数据，其中包含较大内部数据部分。
  • 推理时 scaling 对重复 pointwise score 求和；Meta RM guided voting 会评估采样的判断轨迹。
  • 官方列出 16B、27B 与 MetaRM checkpoint，但原始数据、critique 和代码未确认。
  • 奖励 benchmark scaling 评测的是 judge pipeline，不是轨迹或来源混合质量证明。
